diagnosis: Block-private histograms eliminate the performance bottleneck. Only the refined-coordinate K256 role crosses the frozen code-mismatch fraction, by 0.000003403; its centroid error still passes. The other three coordinate roles pass and run 21.9x to 28.1x faster than serial.
decision: Reject the all-coordinate hierarchical allocation without relaxing correctness. Under a new preregistration, retain refined coordinates on the previously validated reference grouped path and use hierarchical histograms only for c_fc residual, c_proj residual, and base coordinates.
